editorial:
Imagine a future where governments are gone and giant companies run everything. You are dropped into a world where the Mishima Zaibatsu holds a brutal fighting tournament called Tekken just to keep people distracted from their miserable lives. You follow Jin Kazama, a guy with a deep grudge and a lot of skill, as he enters the fight to take down the corporation. The vibe is very much like an old-school arcade game brought to life, filled with neon lights, high-tech gadgets, and plenty of punching and kicking. It feels like a wild ride where the stakes are high and the action never really stops.

You will probably love the fight scenes, though some of the acting feels a bit stiff at times. The pacing is fast, which keeps you from getting bored, even if the story is pretty simple. If you are a fan of martial arts or gaming, you should definitely give this a shot. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the fight choreography clearly. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Jin fights Heihachi Mishima in a huge battle. Jin manages to use his strength and skills to defeat Heihachi, finally getting his revenge. He stops the corporate greed of the Mishima Zaibatsu and proves he is the strongest fighter. The movie wraps up with Jin winning the tournament, showing that a single person can take down a powerful empire if they are tough enough.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves martial arts movies and fighting games.
